src.title: 6 ingredient lemon olive oil honey cake

recipes.title: 6-Ingredient Lemon Olive Oil Honey Cake (oat flour)
steps: Boil the whole lemon for 25 minutes until soft. Cut it open and remove the seeds.
Blend the lemon with the olive oil, honey and eggs until smooth.
Stir the blended mixture into the oat flour, baking powder and salt. Cover with a towel and rest 10 minutes at room temperature so the cake isn't gummy.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Pour into a lined loaf pan and bake about 40 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool, then drizzle with whipped honey if you like and slice.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's; macros are estimated per slice (about 2,270 kcal for the whole cake per a commenter, plus ~255 for the glaze). Several people found the whole boiled lemon bitter; for a milder cake, zest it, then peel off the white pith before blending.
